name: Campo Largo
source:
Elder Travis Hartley is right on track.

He's spent the last six months getting accustomed to life as a Mormon missionary in the South American nation of Paraná.

Now, however, come two big shifts: he's been reassigned to a small rural town that hasn't hosted missionaries for years — and to train a brand-new missionary. Both big responsibilities.

Bundled off on a bus beside his new companion, Elder Hartley has his work cut out for him: getting to know his companion, the local church members, and the town, all while spending ten hours per day in the sweltering January sun trying to find and teach anyone, [i]anyone[/i], who's interested.

He knows who he is and why he's here. He knows how to be personable, how to preach, how to plan. He's got this. Yeah.

Everything is fine!

That is, of course, until everything starts to go... off the rails. In unsettling ways. [I]Impossible[/i] ways. Ways he can't believe or explain...

[From [url=https://toledo-art.itch.io/campo-largo]Itch.io[/url]]
